jobs.description: Was Sie erwartetMöchtest du dazu beitragen, den weltweiten Übergang zur nachhaltigen Energie zu beschleunigen?  Bei Tesla ist das unsere Mission! Wir suchen talentierte Kfz-Technikerinnen für Teslas Service Center in ganz Deutschland. Bei Tesla sind unsere Mechanikerinnen das Rückgrat des Servicebetriebs und unterstützen unsere Mission, den weltweiten Übergang zu nachhaltiger Energie zu beschleunigen. Wir haben eines der innovativsten Fahrzeuge aller Zeiten entwickelt, und als Servicetechniker*in trägst du dazu bei, unserer Kundschaft einen ebenso innovativen Service zu bieten. Wir bieten:- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. Hochvoltschulungen, Managementtrainings)- Unternehmenskultur: Tauche ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft im Mittelpunkt stehen- Innovative Projekte und Technologien: Du hast die Chance, an wegweisenden Projekten und Technologien zu arbeiten, die die Zukunft der Automobilindustrie und nachhaltiger Energie mitgestalten- Vorteile und Zusatzleistungen: Dich erwartet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalts- und Leistungspaket, das neben Tesla Aktien oder einem CashAward auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm, 30 Tage Urlaub, ein 13. Monatsgehalt sowie die Option auf eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket umfasst - Engagiertes Team und positive Arbeitsatmosphäre: Arbeite in einem engagierten und motivierten Team, das sich durch eine tolle Stimmung und hervorragende Teamarbeit auszeichnet. Sei Teil eines Teams, das einen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Zukunft und zu erneuerbaren Energien leistet  Was zu tun ist- Service, Reparatur und Verbesserung: Mit Tesla-spezifischer Software und fortschrittlichen Tools führst du Reparaturen und Wartungen an allen Arten von Tesla-Fahrzeugen durch  - Qualitätssicherstellung: Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du unsere Fahrzeuge vor der Rückgabe und Vorablieferung sorgfältig prüfst und mit dem höchsten Qualitätsstandards arbeitest - Zusammenarbeit: Wenn du teamübergreifend (lokal und regional) arbeitest, tausche dich aus und Teile deine Erfahrung, um das Serviceerlebnis weiter zu verbessern - Entwicklung: Bereite dich auf den Erfolg vor. Unsere engagierten internen Schulungsteams schulen dich in Tesla-spezifischer Technologie und der Reparatur von Elektrofahrzeugen Was mitzubringen ist- Technische Erfahrung: Du verfügst über Berufserfahrung in der Durchführung von Fahrzeugservice und Reparaturarbeiten in der Automobil-, Luftfahrt-, Marine- oder ähnlichen Industrien - Technische Qualifizierung: Du verfügst über eine entsprechende Zertifizierung, um in Deutschland Fahrzeugreparaturen durchführen zu können (Ausbildung zum Mechatroniker*in) - Verantwortlichkeit: Du übernimmst eine Vorreiterrolle bei Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsbedenken, die während der Arbeit auftreten - Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du sprichst und schreibst gut Deutsch und weißt, wie du deinen Standpunkt klar und respektvoll vermitteln kannst - Teamfähigkeit und Flexibilität: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen und kannst gute Arbeitsbeziehungen zu allen internen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen. Du kannst im Schichtdienst arbeiten, um dein Team zu unterstützen. Dies können auch Wochenenden sowie Morgen- und Abendschichten umfassen (bei einer 5-Tage Woche) - Fahrerlaubnis: Du besitzt einen gültigen EU-Führerschein der Klasse B - Berechtigung: Du besitzt eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für DeutschlandENGLISH VERSIONPlease note that experience or training in the automotive sector is crucial for the recognition of your qualifications. Therefore, while we can initiate the recruiting process immediately, we can only issue a final employment contract once the recognition of your vocational training in Germany is fully completed.Further information can be found at: https://www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de/html/en/getting-recognition.phpWe are looking for talented Automotive Technicians for Tesla's Service Centers. At Tesla, our Mechanics are the backbone of the Service operation, supporting our mission. We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made, and as a Service Technician you will help ensure an equally innovative service to our customers.We offer:Provision and Additional Benefits• Above-average salary• 13th-month salary• Choice between Tesla stock or a cash bonus• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (opportunity to purchase Tesla stock at a discounted price)• Permanent employment contract• Saturday work allowance of 25%• Company pension scheme• Life insurance• Occupational disability insurance• Accident insurance for business travel• Further insurance discounts• Bonuses for successful employee referralsDiscounts and Recognition• Tesla apparel and workwear (incl. laptop for work)• Exclusive corporate benefits• Discount in the Tesla Online Shop• Upgrade option to “Full Self-Driving Capability”Health and Wellbeing• Choice between a discounted Urban Sports Club membership or a wellness allowance• 30 days of vacation• Special leave for events such as moving, marriage, or bereavement• Employee Assistance Program “Fürstenberg” (free, confidential support for personal or professional challenges)• Company doctor, medical checks, and consultations• Additional personal work equipment (e.g., computer glasses)• Free drinks and fruit• Overtime meals/cateringMobility and Transport• Subsidized “Deutschland-Job-Ticket”• Next Bike rental discounts• Job Bike leasing (tax-advantaged)Learning and Development• Online learning platform• Internal training programs (including topics such as high-voltage training and leadership training)• Onboarding in Berlin• Regular feedback sessions and performance reviewsWhat You’ll DoYou will- Service, repair and improve: Working with Tesla specific software and advanced tools you will be performing repairs and maintenance on all types of Tesla vehicles, with and without supervision according to skill level- Ensure top quality: Fix it right first time, we trust you to inspect our vehicles diligently before return and pre-delivery and to work with the highest quality standards- Collaborate: Working across teams (local and regional) you will be sharing support and best practices to further improve the service experience- Develop: Setting you up for success, our dedicated in-house training teams will train you on Tesla specific technology and the repair of Electrical VehiclesWhat You’ll Bring- Technically experienced: You have professional experience performing vehicle service and repairs working within either automotive, aviation, marine or similar industries,- Technically qualified: You ideally have relevant certification to perform vehicle repairs. However, this is not a requirement. You will self-manage your technical expertise development,- A good communicator: You speak and write English well and know how to get your point across clearly and respectfully- Safe to drive: We require you to hold a full driver’s license- Flexible: You may work in shifts to support your team, which may include weekends, morning, and evening shifts. You are willing to travel for mobile repairs when needed.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Korrosionsschutz, Fahrzeuglackierung, KarosseriearbeitenExpertenkenntnisse: Fahrzeugdiagnose, Fahrzeugsysteme-Mechatronik

Purpose of your JobAre you looking for a career in research & development of biopharmaceuticals or in general in the pharmaceutical industry?Then join Coriolis Pharma and contribute with state-of-the-art capillary electrophoresis analytics to our formulations and lyophilization processes for biopharmaceutical drugs!You will join a highly motivated, interdisciplinary team performing contract research and development for customers in the (bio) pharmaceutical industry worldwide.You will be a vital part of our contract research organization – where you will support & learn from our scientific operations teams – to enable our clients in their journey of developing innovative drugs.Your ResponsibilityAs Senior Scientist you are - together with the project team - responsible for the successful development and execution of capillary electrophoresis (CE) analysis for our customers worldwide.  - Responsible—as subject matter expert—for supporting client project acquisition and execution with expertise to ensure high-quality services.- Accountable for the electrophoretic characterization of biopharmaceutical molecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids) within client projects, including the de novo development of CE methods and the interpretation of data in context with other analytical approaches (such as LC-MS or LC-IEX).- Maintain cutting-edge scientific knowledge in CE and related areas and drive CE innovation to meet evolving business needs, including new business areas and novel molecular modalities.- Work cooperatively across Coriolis teams (e.g., business development, finance, technical support team) to ensure seamless collaboration with all operational groups during client project execution.- Function as project leader for assigned client projects, overseeing project planning, method implementation, development, characterization, data evaluation, and reporting activities.What you need to succeed- University degree in analytical chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, (bio)chemistry, or a related field; a PhD related to separation sciences—ideally focused on CE applications / method development and associated areas—is preferred- Minimum 5 years of industry experience (with PhD in a relevant field) or 9 years (without PhD) with in-depth knowledge of biopharmaceutical characterization by CE (CE-SDS, CZE, cIEF) using UV, PDA, LIF, or FLD detection- Several years of hands-on experience with CE instruments from different vendors (e.g., Sciex, BioTechne/ProteinSimple, Agilent, etc.)- Proven experience in developing, transferring, and troubleshooting CE (and associated) analytical methods in an industry setting, including both R&D and GMP environments- Demonstrated project management skills, including resource management, multitasking, prioritization, and risk management- Strong lateral leadership capabilities, with leading by example as a natural approach- Hands-on, proactive mindset with openness to new ideas and tasks; a can-do attitude is essential- Team-oriented personality with strong motivational and interpersonal skills- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

regular site visits within the cluster• Responsible for expertise topics or special tasks as well as support expertise topics in the EU network• Assumption of tasks for the Amazon network for the continuous improvement of our concept in company health management• SME function for one of the Health Core Topics including conception of program, communication, roll-out support, tool development, e.g. This is to be implemented after consultation with the Regional Health Manager.• Conduction or coordination of upcoming projects or roll-outs with different topics• Close cooperation with the EU/ DE WHS team• Alignment and coordination with expert teams or program managers to monitor, communicate, or update program standards to the sites...Notwendige Qualifikationen:• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in occupational health and/ or safety management, health sciences, health promotion, health economics, comparable studies or postgraduate studies related to health care and relevant professional experiences• Experience in the implementation and realization of occupational health measures, among others in cooperation with the operational representations of employees' interests and internal key functions• Experience in people management• Independent and result-oriented working method and problem solving• Very good Microsoft Office skills• Analytical and interpretive skills• Knowledge of internal communication and documentation• Very good communication skills• Very good communication skills in English and GermanWünschenswerte Qualifikationen:• Experience in health management in industry or logistics• Experience and qualifications in occupational reintegration management and health care processes/ projects• Ergonomic expertise• Experience in the implementation of process improvements in an occupational environmentBei gleicher Qualifikation werden Schwerbehinderte bevorzugt behandelt.Amazon verfolgt als Arbeitgeber den Grundsatz der Chancengleichheit. Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft wesentlich zu unserem Erfolg beiträgt. Wir treffen Einstellungsentscheidungen auf Grundlage Ihrer Erfahrungen und Qualifikationen. Ihre Begeisterung, Dinge zu entdecken, innovative Konzepte einzubringen, Abläufe zu vereinfachen und Neues aufzubauen, wissen wir zu schätzen. Amazon nimmt den Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten ernst und respektiert die nationalen Datenschutzgesetze sowie die EU-Rechtsvorschriften zum Datenschutz. Sofern nicht anders vereinbart, erlauben Sie dem einstellenden Unternehmen von Amazon durch Einreichung Ihres Lebenslaufs, Ihre persönlichen Daten in der elektronischen Datenbank zu speichern, die von Amazon Corporate LLC. in den USA oder von einer Tochtergesellschaft zum Zweck der Feststellung Ihrer Eignung für diese und für zukünftig angebotene Stellen sowie zur Verfolgung Ihres Bewerbungsprozesses unterhalten wird. Wenn Sie wünschen, dass Ihre persönlichen Daten gelöscht werden, können Sie das einstellende Unternehmen jederzeit darüber benachrichtigen. Amazon gibt Ihre Daten ohne Ihre vorherige Zustimmung nicht an Dritte weiter. Im Rahmen des Interviewprozesses mit Amazon werden Sie möglicherweise dazu aufgefordert, dem einstellenden Unternehmen von Amazon zu gestatten, Ihre Bewerbungsdaten und Ihren Lebenslauf separat durch einen Drittanbieter prüfen zu lassen.

jobs.occupation: Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural Validation (Statiker/in)
jobs.description: Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural ValidationHelp Accelerate Industrial DecarbonizationJoin exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology. Your ImpactThe structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.What You'll DoDesign & Improve Structural Systems- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.Lead Material & Component Testing- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.Develop & Validate Engineering Models- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.- Validate simulation results through physical testing.- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.Collaborate Across Engineering- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.Who You AreYou're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.Ideally, you'll bring:- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.What You'll Find at GlassPoint- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization. We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation. GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Materialwissenschaft, Konstruktion, Versuchsdurchführung und -auswertung

jobs.description: The German Institute of Human Nutrition Potsdam-Rehbruecke (DIfE) (https://www.dife.de/en/) is a member of the Leibniz Association. The institute’s mission is to conduct experimental and clinical research in the field of nutrition and health, with the aim of understanding the molecular basis of nutrition-dependent diseases, and of developing new strategies for treatment and prevention.The Junior Research Group of Gut-Brain Interactions (GBI) (https://www.dife.de/en/research/departments-and-labs/gut-brain-interactions/)  invites applications for1 Postdoc (m/f/d)starting May 1, 2027.Project descriptionThe project investigates how signals from the stomach interact with brain systems supporting arousal, attention and cognition. Combining electrogastrography (EGG) with EEG, fMRI and peripheral physiology, we study the neural dynamics of stomach–brain coupling in healthy individuals. A central aim is to determine whether experimentally induced changes in arousal influence gastric–brain coupling independently of changes in gastric activity, and how these dynamics relate to vigilance and behaviour. The postdoc will lead electrophysiological and multimodal analyses, contribute to experiments involving pharmacological and physiological manipulations, and have scope to develop an independent research line within the programme.Skills and Requirements- Excellent Master degree and doctoral degree in the areas of Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience or Biology- Strong background in electrophysiology (EEG, MEG, Intracranial EEG) and/or strong background in neuroimaging (fMRI data analysis, SPM, FSL)- Solid understanding of statistics and signal processing and Python/Matlab- High motivation for interdisciplinary research on brain–body interactions- Experience with physiological data (EGG, ECG, Respiration, Pupil) or Psychophysics is an asset- Proficiency in English (spoken and written)- Very high motivation and willingness for interdisciplinary collaboration in a diverse research environmentWe offer:- Excellent technical equipment, a wide range of experimental methods and a dynamic and interactive research environment- Remuneration according to TV-L, level 13, plus annual special payment and company pension scheme- Family-friendly working conditions (certificate “audit berufundfamilie”)- Supporting of mobility with a jobticket for using the public transport- Easy accessibility by public transport or car (including free parking)- 30 days of vacation- Participation in the benefits program for employees („Corporate Benefits“)The advertised position is available for 1 year with the option of extension.We promote the employment of people with severe disabilities and are committed to equal opportunities for them. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration if they have the same qualifications.Please send your documents (cover letter explaining your motivation, CV, copies of degrees/certificates and references) with reference number 2026_W11_BA as a single pdf-file before November 30, 2026 via e-mail to jobs@dife.de (https://mailto:jobs@dife.de) . For further information please do not hesitate to contact: Dr. Ignacio RebolloHead of Junior Research Group Gut Brain Interactions (GBI)E-Mail: Ignacio.Rebollo@dife.de (https://mailto:Ignacio.Rebollo@dife.de)  We process your application documents for the purpose of carrying out the application procedure in accordance with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b) GDPR, Art. 88 GDPR. For more information on the collection, processing and use of personal data by the German Institute of Human Nutrition as part of the application process and your rights under data protection law, please contact the Department of Human Resources and Social Services (jobs@dife.de (https://mailto:jobs@dife.de) ).Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: StatistikErweiterte Kenntnisse: Psychologie, Neurobiologie, Neurowissenschaften (Neuroscience), Neurophysiologie

PhD Position (E13, 65%) in Tumor ImmunologyThe Chair for Infection Pathogenesis is looking for academic staff, starting as soon as possible.BackgroundWe are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate (E13, 65%) to join a DFG-funded research project investigating the role of tumor-associated neutrophils (TANs) in intestinal polyp dynamics in a pig model. The pig model provides an excellent opportunity to explore the diverse facets of comparative immunology and to bridge fundamental immunological mechanisms with translational research.This project aims to elucidate the function of TANs on polyp growth and regression with a particular focus on their interaction with the local tissue microenvironment and immune response. A key component of the project will be the establishment and use of intestinal organoid–neutrophil co-culture models to study TAN-mediated effects on epithelial and polyp cells. The successful candidate will work in an interdisciplinary research environment using state-of-the-art molecular, cellular, immunological, and organoid-based approaches.Your responsibilitiesThe successful candidate will plan and conduct experimental studies investigating TAN phenotypes and functions during intestinal polyp development. The work combines in vivo studies using transgenic animal models, including animal breeding, sample collection, and histopathological analyses, with in vitro organoid–immune cell co-culture systems and molecular, cellular and immunological assays. The candidate will analyse and interpret the resulting data, present findings at scientific meetings, and contribute to manuscripts and reports. Independent experimental work, careful sample handling, and a high level of scientific responsibility are expected.Your qualifications, key skills and experience- Master’s degree or Staatsexamen or equivalent in Veterinary Medicine, Animal sciences, Medicine, Biology, Biotechnology or related fields- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international team- Strong interest in tumour immunology, inflammation, and gastrointestinal disease- Experience with molecular biology, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, cell culture, or animal models is advantageous- Very good written and spoken English, Strong analysis and problem-solving capacitiesWhat we offerThe candidate will have the opportunity to work in an interdisciplinary and international scientific environment. Research staff is supported by easy access to scientific expertise, well-equipped lab and core facilities and an active science community @Weihenstephan Campus. We offer a three-year PhD position funded by the German Research Foundation (DFG) and an employment according to TV-L E13 (65%).Your applicationIf you are interested in working in our team, please send your application by mail together with a strong CV and supporting documentation to the Chair of Infection Pathogenesis* (friederike.ebner@tum.de)*.Technische Universität MünchenSchool of Life Sciences – Infection PathogenesisProf. Dr. rer. nat.
